load_splits: load the train validation and test index splits for the PCQM4M-LSC dataset
load_kth_fold_indices: load the indices for a specific k-th fold from a pickle file in the data root
load_all_except_kth_fold_indices: load all fold indices except the specified k-th fold for cross-validation training
load_smile_strings: load all SMILES strings from the PCQM4M dataset optionally with their target labels
load_cached_conformers: load a cached dictionary mapping SMILES strings to conformer feature arrays from a pickle file
